hidePlayers.name: Hide the player list
hidePlayers.hint: While the HUD is open, the player list in the bottom-left corner is hidden: the HUD takes its place.

hideHotbar.name: Hide the macro hotbar
hideHotbar.hint: While the HUD is open, the standard macro hotbar is hidden so they do not overlap.

showInitiative.name: Initiative bar
showInitiative.hint: Show the HUD initiative bar at the top of the screen during combat.

collapseOutOfCombat.name: Collapse the HUD out of combat
collapseOutOfCombat.hint: Out of combat only the portrait and the health orb are shown; the rest expands on mouse hover. In combat the HUD is always expanded.

hideChatInput.name: Hide the floating chat input
hideChatInput.hint: While the HUD is open, the chat input, dice tray and roll mode buttons shown over the scene (when another sidebar tab is active) are hidden. The Chat tab keeps its input.
